entries.title: Psalms 134:1
segments: <<A Song of Ascents.>> Behold, bless ye Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah, That by night stand in the house of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 134:2
segments: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 134:3
segments: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion; Even he that made heaven and earth.
